notes.title: New Update brings 3D world map, many fixes and balancing
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

we are happy to release new update marked as v0.56

In this update we focused on campaign missions fixes and difficulty balancing. If the game still feels too difficult for you, make sure to go to settings and adjust to low to have better experience. Another important addition is 3D world map that is now present in the crash site. So now we can finally see where we are fighting!

Here is a short list of major changes:
3D Neon world added in Crashed Ship
Leaderboard map positioning improved
UI improvements in Crashed Ship
Campaign gameplay Improvements and Balancing
Gameplay fixes for all missions
2D UI elements replaced with 3D elements in leaderboards screen
Missing voice notifies added in modes
Fixed overlapping voice notifies
Environment in each map extended with main mountain

Enjoy this update and meanwhile we are already working on the next one which will further improve overall experience.

Cheers,
ASC

notes.title: Update 0.54 out now with new Game Mode!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

we are happy to release new update marked 0.54 which brings bunch of performance improvements and new game mode.

Selected list of changes:
[list]
[*] New Game Mode which will challange your Sword skills
[*] Performance improvements for sword missins
[*] Map Menu Improvements for Interactions
[*] Shield material improvement for better visibility

There is already next update in the works with more new things like crashed space ship and another game mode.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Are you ready to embrace the dangers of Neon VR?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We are very happy to announce our release of Neon VR as Early Access. We are thrilled to get all the possible feedback and implement it in game. 

Neon VR is currently in its alpha version v0.5. Thank you for supporting us and we hope you will enjoy your experience in Neon VR! You can follow us for updates on [url=https://twitter.com/vr_neon]Twitter[/url] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30824830/6e3c9a0a15c8b8698ff3c96273a56fd01ceccf8e.jpg[/img]


[b]Current state of the game:[/b]

At the moment base campaign includes 8 missions and the first challenge mode: Survival with an online leaderboard. In Survival mode, your mission is to survive as many waves of enemies as you can.

[b]Short-term plans:[/b]
[list]
[*] Final 9th mission coming soon in following updates.
[*] Performance polish
[*] Gameplay polish
[*] Upgrade and replacement of alfa assets for creatures & environments
[*] Overall look’n’feel polish
[*] Difficulty polish
[*] Controls polish
[*] Weapon selection and teleportation polish
[*] Improved animations
[/list]

[b]Long-term plans:[/b]
[list]
[*] New monsters
[*] New maps & environments
[*] New challenge modes
[/list]

[b]Stretch points / future plans / Things we will be looking into in the future:[/b]
[list]
[*] Online co-op
[*] More single player campaigns
[/list]

Until then, 
Will you survive the night?!

Cheers!
